original_test_intent: Verify the intended tray survives each approved physical AC/aux removal and restoration, boots to the OS with all expected PCIe devices and shows no unacceptable new AER or platform fault.
original_method: An authorized electrical/hardware operator identifies and isolates the exact tray input, drains workloads, removes and reapplies AC through the approved mechanism and dwell, records physical/power/console evidence, while the agent collects complete post-boot topology and health data.
manual_activity: An authorized operator verifies the labeled tray and feed, removes and restores AC/aux through the approved facility procedure, records the physical event and monitors power/boot before any workload restoration.
required_inputs: Exact rack/tray serial, PSU slots, AC feeds, PDU outlets/breakers/connectors and meaning of aux cycle
Cycle count, minimum off dwell, discharge/inrush timing, power-on/POST/OS timeout
Facility/electrical authorization, PPE/lockout/connector handling and redundancy plan
Workload drain, storage flush, data-loss and outage approval
Expected PCIe identity/link manifest and allowed enumeration changes
Independent console and power/feed observer plus failed-power recovery
Final normal feed/redundancy and workload-restore checks
safety_requirements: Never operate an unlabeled or ambiguous feed, breaker, connector or neighboring tray
Do not hot-unplug a connector unless its service procedure explicitly permits it
Drain workloads and flush storage before physical AC removal
Use facility-approved arc, PPE, lockout and inrush controls and preserve redundancy only as specified
Do not claim physical AC loss from SSH unreachability alone
Stop on arcing, connector/PSU damage, failed discharge/restoration, boot timeout, missing device, AER/DPC, storage/data, thermal/power or recovery fault; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source and approved tray/feed/cycle contract
Prepare per-cycle evidence checklist and monitor independent console/BMC only after operator action
Collect full post-boot topology and health comparison
Perform no physical power operation, PDU control, retry, workload restore or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact AC/aux topology, physical procedure and cycle timing
Approve outage/data state, electrical controls, topology and error criteria
Review operator and per-cycle evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly states no agent command can perform the required physical AC operation. Post-boot collection must expand beyond dmesg to full PCIe, storage and platform health.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use an authorized operator for the physical AC/aux sequence; the agent performs read-only pre/post evidence collection only after the feed and action are independently confirmed.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Physical AC/aux cycle, per-cycle boot/PCIe/AER checks and 10/20-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL CRITICAL TRAY AC/AUX CYCLE WITH FACILITY AND TOPOLOGY INTERLOCKS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the physical feed action to tray identity and an independent console/power timeline; after each restoration, compare a normalized PCIe/link manifest and complete platform health before another cycle.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds feed/PSU identity, electrical safety, discharge/inrush timing, complete topology/error evidence and recovery without automating the physical action.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: BMC DC or warm reboot cannot substitute for loss of AC/aux input. Remote reachability alone cannot prove that the intended feed was physically removed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Redundant feeds or stored energy can keep standby domains alive even after one connector is removed. The operator must prove the specified power boundary was reached while avoiding removal of the wrong feed or loss of the independent recovery path.

project_override_considerations: Remote intelligent-PDU control may be reviewed later only if it is an approved equivalent with exact outlet/tray identity and independent state proof; it is not assumed here and does not remove the physical/facility safety requirements.
expected_evidence: Approved tray/PSU/feed/PDU/connector map, cycle/timing and electrical safety plan
Workload drain/storage flush/outage approval and baseline topology/health
Timestamped operator physical action plus feed/power/console/boot timeline for every cycle
Per-cycle full PCIe identity/link, AER/DPC/kernel/BMC/PSU/storage/thermal evidence
No-wrong-feed/no-DC-substitution/no-auto-retry audit, restored redundancy/workload and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master and DeepSeek agree that the required operation is a physical AC/aux cycle followed by boot/PCIe/AER checks. Missing feed and timing details are execution inputs, not contradictory source claims.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose and physical action are clear and can be performed by an authorized operator under an approved procedure. Agent inability to manipulate AC makes it MANUAL ONLY, not blocked.

review_improvement: Adds exact electrical topology, facility controls and full per-cycle platform evidence while maintaining strict human ownership of the AC action.
independent_technical_reasoning: An AC-cycle test is defined by the actual power boundary crossed, not merely by loss of host connectivity. Redundant inputs and hold-up energy may preserve auxiliary domains, changing firmware and PCIe recovery behavior. Physical feed identity plus independent power/console evidence is therefore required to distinguish a true tray AC/aux cycle from DC control, a network outage or removal of only one redundant source.
